question: Why did my margin drop in September?
summary: Margin fell mainly because 22 hours for Atlas Co were never invoiced, Adobe price rose 20.9% (from 66.99 to 80.99 EUR), Webflow not opened for 94 days, still charged (1363 EUR total impact).

causes.cause: 22 hours for Atlas Co were never invoiced

evidence.sql: SELECT client_id, client_name, month, unbilled_hours, unbilled_pct, hourly_rate, effective_rate FROM client_profitability WHERE unbilled_pct > 10 OR unbilled_hours > 0
SELECT subscription_id, vendor, plan, monthly_cost, first_charge_amount, last_charge_amount, price_change_pct FROM subscription_usage WHERE price_change_pct > 15

causes.cause: Webflow not opened for 94 days, still charged

evidence.sql: SELECT subscription_id, vendor, plan, monthly_cost, last_login_date, days_since_login FROM subscription_usage WHERE days_since_login > 60
